title: fix(kie): include bundled plugin artwork
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Kie's bundled provider is missing both package-local artwork files, so the bundled icon inventory fails and the UI falls back to generic artwork.

## User Impact

Kie now ships package identity artwork and a compact video activity glyph.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the documented OpenClaw fallback mascot and the existing Vydra video glyph byte-for-byte, with source attribution. The existing discovery, packaging and rendering paths already support both assets.

Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160327 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160010.

## Evidence

- Original missing-file failure reproduced in 3.12 s.
- All 19 bundled-asset and metadata-copy tests pass in 2.61 s.
- The actual metadata-copy build step preserves both asset files byte-for-byte; `npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts` includes both.
- Chromium exercised the real Control UI identity/activity loaders and renderers against synthetic authenticated responses. Before: both missing assets produce existing fallbacks. After: identity loads; the SVG decodes into a transparent 256 px PNG mask and renders at 16 px in both themes. Final capture run: 4.19 s.
- Remote proof used a 7 GiB kernel-enforced process-tree cap with swap disabled. Source and asset hashes matched; subsequent attribution-table formatting changes whitespace only.
- Independent byte/source/image review found no actionable P0–P2 issue. The native text autoreview helper does not support binary PNG diffs and produced no verdict.
- Review disposition: removed the release-owned changelog entry as requested; both assets and both attribution files are byte-for-byte unchanged from the reviewed `40aaa8cb15c4f4c2598c77f65cf22f735e6e1ea2` head. Release-note context remains in this PR.
- No runtime or test code changed. Reuse existing inventory and packaging assertions; no new recurring tests or full product build.

### Inspected component screenshots

These are real Control UI components with synthetic HTTP responses, not a live Kie API session.
